title: Kits
loading_failed: The kit catalogue could not be read: {error}
empty: No kits in the catalogue yet.
contents_unavailable: What is inside this kit cannot be read from this Studio yet.
sec_screens_hint: Tabs and sections the shell mounts, and on which level.
screen_not_here: no screen in this portal yet
sec_types_hint: What it adds to the Studio domain model, under its own namespace.
sec_handlers_hint: What reacts to its objects: rules, agent and WebAssembly functions.
sec_services_hint: Containers it deploys for heavy work — never a Studio redeploy.
sec_inbox_hint: What it adds to the list of what waits on a person.
sec_tools_hint: What an agent can do with it, as a person can.
sec_permissions_hint: What it reads, writes and listens to; approved at install, held by the PDP.
sec_material_hint: What it writes into a project checkout: templates, workflows, prompts.
sec_kinds_hint: The kinds of document it brings templates and rules for.
description_platform: Base kits: what the platform installs for every organization. An organization adds kits for itself on its own Kits tab, a project on its own.
description_organization: Kits for this organization: install what it needs on top of the base kits. The base kits are the platform's and stay.
description_project: Kits for this project only, on top of what the platform and the organization installed.
from_platform: Installed by the platform for every organization
add_open: Add a kit from a repository
add_title: Add a kit from a repository
add_hint: Studio reads the kit's manifest (kit.json, or .cf-studio-kit.toml) in the directory you name, pins it to a commit and puts it on this organization's shelf. Only this organization sees it.
add_no_connections: The organization has no shared GitHub or GitLab connection of its own to read a repository through. Add one under Connections first.
add_ref: Branch, tag or commit (the default branch when empty)
add_slug: Kit (only when the manifest lists several)
ide_hint: Official kits written into the project's checkouts: templates, workflows and prompts, pinned to a Git version. Requests go through the backend to the trusted cfs runner in the project's IDE; the browser never runs a kit's scripts.
ide_no_session: The project's IDE is not running, so its repositories are unknown: a kit is recorded now and written into the project repository. Open the IDE and press Refresh to choose another repository.
ide_repositories_failed: The IDE's repositories could not be read: {error}
ide_install_no_session: Recorded, but not written: the project's IDE is not running ({error}). Open the IDE and install again.
ide_empty: No official kits in this Studio's catalogue. The project works without kits meanwhile.
ide_remove_confirm: Remove from this project? Files it already wrote stay in the repositories until they are removed there.
